t: Surgical Refactoring: From Selenium Sprawl to Precision Automation
s: This article details a refactoring of Pipulate's Selenium automation, transforming over-engineered code into a robust, predictable system using AI-guided patching and cleaner design principles.
sub: Iterative AI-guided refactoring for code cleanup
Establishing deterministic file organization for scraped data
Addressing technical debt and third-party warnings
